_comment: Optional deployment release proposal. Set a new semantic version and notes before deploying; Avenue Guard will DM the configured owner and publish it only after approval. Leave version blank when no automatic proposal is needed.
title: Durable operations and request insights
summary: A platform reliability release that makes Discord deliveries recoverable, supervises background work, expands request review tools, and turns operational history into useful staff and impact reporting.
changes: Added a persistent Discord action outbox with idempotent delivery, retries, dead-letter recovery, and saved message IDs
Added a background-task supervisor, historical health samples, provider latency telemetry, and post-deployment smoke checks
Added request notification preferences, live queue aging indicators, validation rechecks, wave comparisons, and structured review analytics
Expanded wave summaries with reviewer throughput and average review time
Added actionable dashboard controls for task restarts, request repair, delivery retries, permission scans, backups, and restore drills
Grouped repeated errors into persistent incidents and added workflow correlation IDs across commands, requests, tickets, and support submissions
Added permission drift scanning across configured channels, ticket categories, logs, summaries, backups, and assignable roles
Added forecast confidence, anomaly detection, automated monthly impact reports, retention controls, and scheduled restore drills
Added typed config and embed-template validation plus explicit database, runtime, config, and template schema versions
Split validation, scheduling, review analytics, diagnostics, backups, and impact forecasting into reusable service modules
